(()=>{const out={};const trs=window.TRS||[16];for(const tr of trs){PT8.launch(Object.assign(tr>=14||tr===PT8.RING_IDX?{rally:true,circuit:true}:{},{mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]}));const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;let ev=[],cur=null,t=0;for(let i=0;i<60*1200;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'&&i>60*20)RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state!=='race')continue;if((c.lapT||[]).length>=1)break;t++;const a=c.m.wheels.every(w=>!w.g)&&c.sp>8&&c.respT<=0;if(a){if(!cur)cur={k:c.idx,t:0,sp:Math.round(c.sp*3.6),vy0:+c.vy.toFixed(1),mx:0};cur.t++;cur.mx=Math.max(cur.mx,c.y-T.y[c.idx])}else if(cur){if(cur.t>=4)ev.push([cur.k,+(cur.t/60).toFixed(2),cur.sp,cur.vy0,+cur.mx.toFixed(2)]);cur=null}}out[tr]={n:ev.length,lap:(c.lapT||[]).map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)),ev:ev.slice(0,40)};PT8.cleanupRace&&PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
